VHM LIMITED
  Goschen Project Community Update
   ISSUE 9 APRIL 2026



                                                               GOSCHEN PROJECT

2026 AND BEYOND
A transformational year for the Goschen Project — and for the communities it will serve.
VHM has reached a defining milestone. With all major approvals and permits now secured, the Goschen
Project is fully permitted to commence mining operations. This is the culmination of years of meticulous
planning, community engagement, and regulatory work — and  it positions VHM as one of Australia’s
most advanced mineral sands development companies.
The focus now turns to project financing and Final Investment Decision (FID), which we are targeting for
completion by June 2026. VHM is actively engaged in discussions with a range of, offtake partners,
strategic investors and financiers, and momentum is building. Once FID is achieved, we will be positioned
to break ground before the end of 2026, commencing construction of the on-site processing plant, water
pipeline, and supporting infrastructure that will underpin decades of productive operation.


 ✨ KEY MILESTONES AHEAD
      All mining approvals and permits obtained  ✔
  ● Final Investment Decision (FID) — targeted June 2026
  ● Construction commencement — targeted late 2026
  ● Processing plant, water pipeline & site infrastructure delivered

  GOSCHEN DRILLING PROGRAM
    Strengthening our Resource and Reserve estimates — March & April 2026

VHM  is currently conducting an active  drilling campaign
across the mine licence area throughout March and April
2026. This program is a critical step on our path to FID,
enhancing our geological data that will further refine and
strengthen our Resource and Reserve estimates.
Every core sample retrieved brings us closer to unlocking the
full potential of the Goschen deposit — one of Australia’s
most significant mineral sands projects. The data gathered
will underpin the investment case we present to prospective
partners and financiers as we approach our FID milestone.

                                                                            Active drilling at the Goschen mine licence site

  COMMUNITY REFERENCE GROUP
   Your Voice. Your Community. Your Project.

With all regulatory approvals now in place, VHM is proud to announce the formation of a Community
Reference Group (CRG) — a formal channel for residents and stakeholders to stay informed, ask
questions, and contribute meaningfully to how the Goschen Project is planned and managed.
The CRG will be independently chaired to ensure open, balanced dialogue. Meetings are expected to be
held quarterly, with the inaugural meeting convened once FID has been achieved and the group is fully
established — targeted for second half 2026.
The Community Reference Group will:
→ Provide timely, transparent updates on Project activities and progress
→ Support genuine community input into planning and operational decisions
→ Offer a constructive platform to raise questions, share feedback, and explore ideas


  📧📧 INTERESTED IN JOINING?
  We welcome expressions of interest from community members who would like to participate.
   Contact us at community@vhmltd.com.au

COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIP SPOTLIGHT
 Proud to support VIVID

                          VHM was delighted to welcome the VIVID workcrew to
                                                  site to assemble the sample bins and surveyor pegs that
                                        are essential to our current drilling program.
                                     VIVID is a government-funded community organisation
                                              that  creates  meaningful employment pathways  for
                                       people  living with  disabilities. Their team delivered
                                         outstanding work, and it was genuinely inspiring to see
                                                  their skills and dedication on display at Goschen.
                                         At VHM, we believe that a great mine is built on great
                                      community. Supporting organisations like VIVID is not
                                                 just good practice — it’s a reflection of our values and
                                        our commitment  to ensuring  the Goschen  Project
                                             delivers lasting benefit across the region.

                                    Contact Vivid here: https://www.wearevivid.org.au/
  The VIVID team on site at Goschen
